title: ${params && params[0] ? ('运维记录 · ' + params[0]) : '运维记录'}
_note: params 在页面 schema 模板中有(由 app.js 注入 data域),但 adaptor 作用域仅 payload;故由 page-title 模板把 params[0] 设入 data.project 供 adaptor 使用

body.name: act-loader
body._note: 运维记录页主 service:跨项目拉 /api/admin-activities(无 project 参数);单项目路由 #/activities/:project 带 ?project= 过滤(behavior.md §7)

api.adaptor: var raw = payload; var rp = (context && context.params) || []; var single = rp[0] || null; var allActs; var projects = []; if (raw && Array.isArray(raw.projects)) { raw.projects.forEach(function(p){ projects.push({ name: p.name, count: (p.activities||[]).length }); }); allActs = []; raw.projects.forEach(function(p){ (p.activities||[]).forEach(function(a){ a.project = p.name; allActs.push(a); }); }); } else if (raw && raw.project) { projects = [{ name: raw.project, count: (raw.activities||[]).length }]; allActs = window.Adapters.adaptActivities(raw.activities || []); } else { allActs = []; } return { status: 0, data: { allActivities: allActs, projects: projects, isSingle: !!single, project: single, total: allActs.length } };

body._note: 跨项目页签:全部 + 各项目(按名排序);单项目模式隐藏(behavior.md §7)
